lead_raw_text:
The structure of CaMg2 (Ca2Mg4 per unit cell) crystallizes in orthorhombic symmetry with space group Amm2 (No. 38). It contains six atoms distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows both Ca and Mg centers with 12 geometric neighbors, adopting a close-packed-like local arrangement, with neighbor distances ranging from about 3.11 to 3.47 Å. The resulting geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals Ca–Mg and Mg–Mg 12-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibiting corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
